prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'product_customer_sees': 'Billing Disputes Handler', 'environment': 'sandbox', 'region': 'LATAM', 'symptoms_observed': ['overcharge', 'payment declined'], 'reported_business_impact': 'high', 'reported_affected_users': 126, 'narrative_instruction': "The customer names the product given as 'product the customer believes is affected' (which may differ from the actual affected product) — write the ticket as if that's the product they think is broken."}]

response: {"cases": [{"i": 0, "title": "URGENT: Billing Disputes Handler rejecting payments and charging wrong amounts", "description": "We are seeing a critical issue with the Billing Disputes Handler in our sandbox environment. Since yesterday, about 126 users in the LATAM region have had their payments declined even though we have funds available. Worse, when the system does process, it's overcharging us significantly compared to the expected rates. This is blocking our launch testing and causing a high business impact. Please check why the Billing Disputes Handler is malfunctioning."}]}
